cards.name: Bat Whisperer
cards.oracleText: When this creature enters, if an opponent lost life this turn, create a 1/1 black Bat creature token with flying.

cards.name: Batwing Brume
cards.oracleText: Prevent all combat damage that would be dealt this turn if {W} was spent to cast this spell. Each player loses 1 life for each attacking creature they control if {B} was spent to cast this spell. (Do both if {W}{B} was spent.)
